answer: Make every new identity post a refundable stake bond, then require a steady signed heartbeat pulse to stay active. Honest agents earn compounding reputation over time, but a sybil farm must fund each clone separately, so its costs spiral faster than any yield it can skim. Forging a swarm becomes as thankless as writing a sonnet for an empty room: the attacker pays heavily upfront while the network verifies each bond cheaply.
